subject: [PATCH v2 0/3] mm: reject zone device folios in more folio walkers

reviews.author: Balbir Singh
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the current patch only rejects zone device private THPs, but does not account for device-coherent THPs which should also be supported and migrated
reviews.raw_body:
A similar patch was sent out earlier, but that was only for zone device
private THP, we don't support migration of device coherent THP today (we
should add support). The patch itself makes sense

Reviewed-by: Balbir Singh <balbirs@nvidia.com>

reviews.author: Lance Yang
reviews.summary: Reviewer Lance Yang successfully tested the patch series on x86_64 QEMU and confirmed that it fixes a kernel panic issue when using PMD-mapped device-coherent THPs, but noted that without these patches, partial MADV_FREE and MADV_COLD operations would reliably hit a kernel panic in remove_migration_pte()
reviews.raw_body:
Cool!

Gave the whole series a spin on x86_64 QEMU with a PMD-mapped
device-coherent THP. Without these patches, partial MADV_FREE and
MADV_COLD reliably hit a kernel panic in remove_migration_pte(), while
mbind(MPOL_MF_MOVE | MPOL_MF_STRICT) returned -EIO.

With v2, all three worked fine, PMD mapping stayed intact, and data
checked out :)

Note that both kernels used the same small change to the in-kernel HMM
test driver, allowing its coherent device memory to be allocated as 2 MB
folios so the PMD-mapped test case could be exercised.

Tested-by: Lance Yang <lance.yang@linux.dev>

reviews.author: Gregory Price (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledges that the patch still has an issue with device-coherent memory, which was previously thought to be resolved.
reviews.raw_body:
Yeah IIRC that was Usama's and I got confused thinking this had already
been resolved - but i realized this still affects device coherent.

ty!

~Gregory

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch series adds missing checks to prevent zone device memory from being reclaimed, aged, or migrated in certain mm walkers. The existing checks only filtered out non-present device-private entries, but did not account for present zone device PMDs. The patches add explicit checks after the folio is resolved and before it is acted upon, ensuring correctness and hardening the kernel against potential issues.

2026-08-17.patch_summary: This patch series adds missing checks for ZONE_DEVICE memory in various mm walkers, ensuring that device-coherent PMDs are properly handled and preventing potential kernel panics.
